name: (Bi,Sb)2Te3 p-type alloy
summary: Solid solution between Bi2Te3 and Sb2Te3. Alloying tunes the carrier concentration and scatters phonons. Composition near Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3 is the standard p-type Peltier leg. In thin films, (Bi,Sb)2Te3 is also used to place the Fermi level inside the bulk gap of the topological insulator.

highlights.conditions: Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3 with dense dislocation arrays (liquid-phase compaction)
